assumptions: Daily hazards are piecewise discrete and each candidate can first occur at most once.
Known signals decay exponentially; parent events change descendant log odds within explicit lag windows.
Event impacts decay exponentially and may alter downstream state-condition hazards.
warnings: Event probabilities are conditional on the supplied candidates, base rates, signals, and mechanism weights.
Candidate omission can dominate forecast error; absence from this forecast does not mean impossibility.
Probability calibration requires temporally held-out historical outcomes for the target domain.
Intervention deltas use common random numbers and are model-based counterfactuals, not identified causal effects.
disclaimer: 本结果为概率模拟与条件预测，不构成对现实结果的保证。
